description: Opt-in: automerge low-risk updates once every required check passes, including the deps-review check from voidflow's agentic package. Use only on repos where deps-review is a required check (see README). Extend after the base preset: { "extends": ["github>taraxvoid/voidflow", "github>taraxvoid/voidflow:deps-review-automerge"] }

packageRules.description: Low-risk update types on 1.0+ versions; lockfile maintenance is excluded because deps-signals cannot verify transitive updates. GitHub auto-merge (platformAutomerge) waits for every required check on the current head, so a Renovate rebase is re-reviewed before it can merge.
